questions.question: How many people came to your weekly events, and what did you change to keep them coming back?
questions.whyTheyAsk: They want to check the number on your CV is real and that you know what drove it.
questions.prepTip: Know your typical attendance and how you counted it (sign-ups, ticket sales). Pick one change you made yourself and what happened next.

questions.question: Where did the 1,200 listings come from, and what did cleaning them involve?
questions.whyTheyAsk: A credit analyst works with messy data every day, so they check you really handled the dataset yourself.
questions.prepTip: Have two or three concrete cleaning steps ready (duplicates, missing rents, odd postcodes) and say which part you did in Python and which in SQL.
